messages.author: e251dfe1bb017bb7
messages.subject: DartR for R ver 4.1.0?
parts:
I updated R to R4.1.0 and received the chilling error message "package ‘dartR’ is not available for this version of R"

Is there some way for me to again gain access to DartR--I am using a number of its functions.

Janice Boyd
Texas A&M University

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] DartR for R ver 4.1.0?
parts:
Hi Janice,

To install the latest package manually follow the description below:

The installation of the package might not run smoothly, as it requires additional bioconductor packages that need to be installed. To install the packages and all dependencies copy paste the script below into your R-console. (If you are lucky it simply installs all packages without any error message and you are done):

install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)
install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install(c("SNPRelate", "qvalue"))
install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR")
library(dartR)
Please let us know whether it worked for you.

Cheers,
Luis

messages.subject: Re: [dartR] DartR for R ver 4.1.0?
parts:
Hi,

THE newest version is just uploaded to Cran, but it takes some day until they update.

best to install the new cran version via github 

library(devtools)
install_github(“green-striped-gecko/dartR”)

should do the trick. (be aware you cannot copy the code from here as the quotes are non-ascii quotes)

the new version is 1.9.9 and i just tested with r-devel

Cheers, Bernd

Thanks to both who sent me possible fixes for using dartR with R version 4.1.0.
Friday afternoon 28 May 2021 at about 1400 Central Daylight Time in Texas the suggestion by Bernd didn't work but the suggestion by Luis did work.  Later that evening Bernd's suggestion seemed to work and I did not need to run Luis' code.  Presumably Cran worked its magic?

Well, anyway, it looks like both or one or the other should work for others when they upgrade their R version.  At least for a while.

Isn't R fun?!  (not)

Thanks Bernd and Luis

Jance Boyd
Texas A&M University
